title: CUBE Registry Community Result
description: Schema for one community-submitted evaluation result. One file per experiment-level run, stored at results/<cube-id>/<evaluation_id>.json. See openspec/changes/results-journal/ for design rationale.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Bumped on any non-backward-compatible change to this file.

evaluation_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this run within results/<cube-id>/. Format: <submitter>/<run-name>. Slashes are replaced with __ in the filename.

evaluation_timestamp.description: Unix epoch seconds when the experiment started.

supersedes.description: Optional evaluation_id of a prior submission this one corrects. The journal is append-only; mistakes are fixed by submitting a new record that supersedes the old.

eval_library.description: The harness / evaluation library that ran the experiment.

name.description: Library name (e.g. cube-harness, inspect_ai, lm_eval, helm).

agent.description: Agent descriptor: enough to identify and re-instantiate the agent that produced this result.

agent_id.description: SHA-256 of the serialized agent config; stable across runs of the same config.

config_type.description: Agent config class name (e.g. ReActConfig, GennyConfig).

llm_model.description: LLM identifier in LiteLLM/provider-prefixed form (e.g. azure/gpt-5.4-mini, anthropic/claude-opus-4-7).

framework_version.description: Version of the eval library at the time of the run (typically matches eval_library.version).

dependency_versions.description: Installed versions of every distribution imported into the experiment's process at run time, minus a curated denylist of behaviorally-inert plumbing.

primary_dependencies.description: Subset of dependency_versions whose drift most directly affects scores (LLM gateway + provider SDKs, tokenizers, env runtimes, schema validation). UIs render these prominently; the rest stay in dependency_versions.

git_commit.description: Git SHA-1 of the eval library's repo HEAD at run time.

git_remote_url.description: Permanent URL pointing to the exact commit (e.g. https://github.com/.../tree/<sha>).

git_is_dirty.description: True if the eval library had uncommitted changes at run time.

cube_standard_git_commit.description: Optional: git SHA-1 of the installed cube-standard checkout (populated when cube-standard is an editable install).

config.description: Optional: full serialized agent config. Recommended for reproducibility but may be omitted if it contains sensitive fields.

benchmark_name.description: Benchmark id; must equal the <cube-id> segment of the file path.

benchmark_version.description: Version of the benchmark package the result was produced against.

benchmark_subset.description: Which subset of the benchmark was evaluated.

n_tasks.description: Denominator: number of tasks the subset contains. The outcomes block must sum to this number.

filter.description: Optional: derivation expression (filter string, glob, or named split) used to produce the subset from the full benchmark.

task_ids.description: Optional: explicit task-id list. Use when neither name nor filter uniquely pins the subset; omit when long.

results.description: Aggregate metrics plus mutually-exclusive outcome counts.

avg_score.description: Mean reward across all tasks in the subset.

std_err.description: Standard error of avg_score (typically std_dev / sqrt(n_tasks)).

total_cost_usd.description: Total LLM cost for the run in USD.

avg_wall_time_s.description: Mean per-episode wall-clock time in seconds.

max_steps_per_episode.description: The per-episode step cap that was in force during the run.

outcomes.description: Task-level outcome breakdown. Mutually exclusive and exhaustive: the five counts must sum to benchmark_subset.n_tasks.

n_success.description: Episodes that reached done=True with reward > 0.

n_failure.description: Episodes that reached done=True with reward == 0 (clean fail per the verifier).

n_max_steps.description: Episodes the loop exited because the step cap fired before done=True (no agent crash).

n_system_error.description: Episodes aborted with an exception (agent crash, infra failure, tool error).

n_missing.description: Tasks in the subset that were never attempted (e.g. infra unavailable).

findings_summary.description: Optional: counts per investigator blame-category, when a post-hoc investigator ran.

instance_results_url.description: Optional: pointer to externally-hosted per-task data (e.g. JSONL on HuggingFace). The registry journal stores aggregates only.
